extracted.intended_audience: issuers/registrants of asset-backed securities, loan servicers, compliance officers preparing loan-level ABS disclosure under Regulation S-K
extracted.subtask_description: Detailed regulatory specification of loan-level data fields and reporting requirements for asset-backed securities (ABS) registration statements (Regulation S-K, Part 229). Intended to guide preparation and submission of the required data elements for each loan in an ABS pool.

rubrics_metrics.name: Total origination and discount points
rubrics_metrics.description: Provide the amount paid to the lender to increase the lender's effective yield and, in the case of discount points, to reduce the interest rate paid by the obligor.

rubrics_metrics.name: Broker
rubrics_metrics.description: Indicate yes or no as to whether a broker originated or was involved in the origination of the loan.

rubrics_metrics.name: Channel
rubrics_metrics.description: Specify the code that describes the source from which the issuer obtained the loan.

rubrics_metrics.name: NMLS company number
rubrics_metrics.description: Specify the National Mortgage License System (NMLS) registration number of the company that originated the loan.

rubrics_metrics.name: Buy down period
rubrics_metrics.description: Indicate the total number of months during which any buy down is in effect, representing the accumulation of all buy down periods.

rubrics_metrics.name: Loan delinquency advance days count
rubrics_metrics.description: Indicate the number of days after which a servicer can stop advancing funds on a delinquent loan.

rubrics_metrics.name: Information related to ARMs
rubrics_metrics.description: If the loan is an adjustable rate mortgage (ARM), provide specified ARM-related fields.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Required ARM subfields include: (i) Original ARM Index (code describing index source/type); (ii) ARM Margin (percentage points added to index); (iii) Fully indexed interest rate (rate to which obligor was underwritten); (iv) Initial fixed rate period for hybrid ARM (months from first payment to first adjustment); (v) Initial interest rate decrease (max % decrease at first adjustment); (vi) Initial interest rate increase (max % increase at first adjustment); (vii) Index look-back (days prior to effective date used to determine index); (viii) Subsequent interest rate reset period (months between adjustments); (ix) Lifetime rate ceiling (maximum interest rate % over life of loan); (x) Lifetime rate floor (minimum interest rate % over life of loan); (xi) Subsequent interest rate decrease (max percentage points decrease at each adjustment after initial); (xii) Subsequent interest rate increase (max percentage points increase at each adjustment after initial); (xiii) Subsequent payment reset period (months between payment adjustments after first adjustment); (xiv) ARM round indicator (code for whether adjusted rate is rounded up/down/nearest); (xv) ARM round percentage (percentage to which rate is rounded); (xvi) Option ARM indicator (yes/no for option ARM); (xvii) Payment method after recast (code describing computation method for lowest monthly payment after recast); (xviii) Initial minimum payment (amount of initial minimum payment permitted); (xix) Convertible indicator (yes/no whether obligor can convert ARM to fixed rate during conversion window); (xx) HELOC indicator (yes/no whether loan is HELOC); (xxi) HELOC draw period (original maximum months from origination during which draws can be made).

rubrics_metrics.name: Information related to prepayment penalties
rubrics_metrics.description: If the obligor is subject to prepayment penalties, provide the following specified information.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Subfields: (i) Prepayment penalty calculation (code describing calculation method); (ii) Prepayment penalty type (code describing type); (iii) Prepayment penalty total term (total months after origination penalty may be in effect); (iv) Prepayment penalty hard term (for hybrid penalties, months after origination during which a 'hard' penalty applies).

rubrics_metrics.name: Information related to negative amortization
rubrics_metrics.description: If the loan allows for negative amortization, provide specified negative-amortization-related fields.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Subfields: (i) Negative amortization limit (maximum negative amortization amount before recalculation); (ii) Initial negative amortization recast period (months after origination negative amortization is allowed); (iii) Subsequent negative amortization recast period (months after which payment must recast after first recast period); (iv) Negative amortization balance amount (amount accumulated as of end of reporting period); (v) Initial fixed payment period (months after origination during which payment is fixed); (vi) Initial periodic payment cap (max % payment increase in first recast period); (vii) Subsequent periodic payment cap (max % increase in one recast period after initial cap); (viii) Initial minimum payment reset period (max months an obligor can pay minimum before new minimum determined); (ix) Subsequent minimum payment reset period (max months after initial period an obligor can continue before new minimum determined); (x) Minimum payment (amount of minimum payment due during reporting period).

rubrics_metrics.name: Information related to the property
rubrics_metrics.description: Property-specific data fields required for each loan.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Include: (1) Geographic location (two-digit zip code); (2) Occupancy status (code describing occupancy at origination); (3) Most recent occupancy status (code from property inspection after origination, if performed); (4) Property type (code describing property securing the loan); (5) Most recent property value (most recent valuation obtained after original appraisal, if any); (6) Most recent property valuation type (code describing valuation method); (7) Most recent property valuation date; (8) Most recent AVM model name (code indicating AVM model if used); (9) Most recent AVM confidence score (confidence score on most recent AVM if obtained after original valuation); (10) Original combined loan-to-value (ratio of all outstanding liens at origination to lesser of appraised value or sales price); (11) Original loan-to-value (ratio of original loan amount to lesser of appraised value or sales price).

rubrics_metrics.name: Information related to the obligor
rubrics_metrics.description: Obligor (borrower) demographic, credit, and verification data required at origination and updates if obtained later.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Include: (1) Original number of obligors; (2) Original obligor credit score (standardized score used at origination); (3) Original obligor credit score type; (4) Most recent obligor credit score (if obtained later); (5) Most recent obligor credit score type; (6) Date of most recent obligor credit score; (7) Obligor income verification level (code describing extent of income verification at origination); (8) 4506–T Indicator (yes/no whether Transcript of Tax Return via IRS Form 4506-T was obtained and considered); (9) Originator front-end debt-to-income (DTI) ratio used to qualify the loan; (10) Originator back-end DTI ratio used to qualify the loan; (11) Obligor employment verification (code describing extent of employment verification); (12) Length of employment—obligor (indicate whether employed by current employer >24 months at origination); (13) Obligor asset verification (code describing extent of asset verification used to qualify the loan); (14) Original pledged assets (total value of assets pledged as collateral instead of down payment at origination); (15) Qualification method (code describing type of mortgage payment used to qualify obligor).

rubrics_metrics.name: Information related to mortgage insurance
rubrics_metrics.description: If mortgage insurance is required, provide insurer and coverage details.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Include: (1) Mortgage insurance company name; (2) Mortgage insurance coverage (total % of original loan balance covered); (3) Pool insurance company (name of provider, if applicable); (4) Pool insurance stop loss percent (aggregate % of pool balance the pool insurer will pay); (5) Mortgage insurance coverage plan type (code describing coverage category).

rubrics_metrics.name: Information related to activity on the loan
rubrics_metrics.description: Loan activity and payment/balance information for the reporting period.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Include the following where applicable: (1) Asset added indicator (yes/no whether asset was added to pool during reporting period). Instruction: required only when assets are added after the final prospectus under § 230.424 is filed. (2) Remaining term to maturity (months from end of reporting period to maturity); (3) Modification indicator—reporting period (yes/no whether asset was modified during reporting period); (4) Next payment due date (for loans not paid off); (5) Advancing method (code indicating servicer responsibility for advancing principal/interest on delinquent loans); (6) Servicing advance methodology (code describing how advances are made); (7) Stop principal and interest advance date (first payment due date for which servicer ceased advancing); (8) Reporting period beginning loan balance (outstanding principal at start of period); (9) Reporting period beginning scheduled loan balance (scheduled principal balance at start); (10) Next reporting period payment amount due (total payment due in next period); (11) Reporting period interest rate (rate in effect during reporting period); (12) Next interest rate (rate in effect for next period if loan not paid off); (13) Servicing fee—percentage (if based on % provide percentage); (14) Servicing fee—flat-fee (if based on flat fee provide monthly fee amount paid to servicers); (15) Other assessed but uncollected servicer fees (cumulative late charges and other assessed fees not paid by obligor); (16) Other loan-level servicing fee(s) retained by the servicer (amount of other fees earned by administrators that reduced remittances, including subservicing/master servicing/trustee fees); (17) Scheduled interest amount (interest payment scheduled for period); (18) Other interest adjustments (unscheduled interest adjustments during period); (19) Scheduled principal amount (scheduled principal payment for period); (20) Other principal adjustments (other amounts causing principal balance changes); (21) Reporting period ending actual balance (actual balance at end of period); (22) Reporting period ending scheduled balance (scheduled principal balance at end); (23) Reporting period scheduled payment amount (total scheduled payment including fees and escrows); (24) Total actual amount paid (total payment including escrows paid to servicer during period); (25) Actual interest collected (gross interest collected during period, whether from obligor or not); (26) Actual principal collected (principal collected during period, whether from obligor or not); (27) Actual other amounts collected (other amounts collected during period); (28) Paid through date (date scheduled principal & interest paid through as of period end); (29) Interest paid through date (date through which interest is paid with payment received during period; effective date for next payment interest calc); (30) Paid-in-full amount (scheduled loan 'paid-in-full' principal amount, excluding current month's scheduled principal; applies to liquidations and payoffs); (31) Information related to servicer advances (see separate servicer-advance subfields and instruction below); (32) Zero balance loans: provide zero balance effective date and zero balance code if balance reduced to zero during period; (33) Most recent 12-month pay history (string indicating monthly payment status from oldest to most recent); (34) Number of payments past due (number of payments past due as of period end); (35) Information related to activity on ARM loans (if ARM, provide rate at next reset; next payment change date; next interest rate change date; payment at next reset; exercised ARM conversion option indicator).

rubrics_metrics.name: Information related to servicer advances (subfields and instruction)
rubrics_metrics.description: Detailed fields capturing amounts advanced and repaid by servicer during reporting period and cumulative balances.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Subfields include: (i) Servicer advanced amount—principal (total advanced for due but unpaid principal during reporting period); (ii) Servicer advanced amounts repaid—principal (payments made by obligor applied to outstanding principal advances during period); (iii) Servicer advances cumulative—principal (outstanding cumulative principal advances as of period end, including advances for period); (iv) Servicer advanced amount—interest (total advanced for due but unpaid interest during period); (v) Servicer advanced amounts repaid—interest (payments made applied to outstanding interest advances); (vi) Servicer advances cumulative—interest (outstanding cumulative interest advances as of period end); (vii) Servicer advanced amount—taxes and insurance (total advanced for due but unpaid property tax and insurance escrow amounts during period); (viii) Servicer advanced amount repaid—taxes and insurance (payments applied to outstanding escrow advances); (ix) Servicer advances cumulative—taxes and insurance (outstanding cumulative escrow advances as of period end); (x) Servicer advanced amount—corporate (total advanced for property inspection and preservation expenses during period); (xi) Servicer advanced amount repaid—corporate (payments applied to outstanding corporate advances); (xii) Servicer advances cumulative—corporate (outstanding cumulative corporate advances as of period end). Instruction: For loans modified or liquidated during a reporting period, the data in these subfields should be as of the liquidation date or modification date, as applicable.

rubrics_metrics.name: Zero balance loans
rubrics_metrics.description: If the loan balance was reduced to zero during the reporting period, provide additional information.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provide (i) Zero balance effective date (date balance reduced to zero) and (ii) Zero balance code (code indicating reason balance reduced to zero).

rubrics_metrics.name: Information related to activity on ARM loans
rubrics_metrics.description: ARM-specific activity fields to report when the loan is an ARM.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Include: (i) Rate at next reset (interest rate used for next scheduled payment if known); (ii) Next payment change date; (iii) Next interest rate change date; (iv) Payment at next reset (principal & interest due after next interest rate change, if known); (v) Exercised ARM conversion option indicator (yes/no whether obligor exercised option to convert ARM to fixed during reporting period).

rubrics_metrics.name: Information related to servicers
rubrics_metrics.description: Identify servicers and servicing transfer information for the loan during the reporting period.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Include: (1) Primary servicer (name of entity that serviced loan during period); (2) Most recent servicing transfer received date (effective date of most recent servicing transfer, if loan transferred); (3) Master servicer (name, if applicable); (4) Special servicer (name, if applicable); (5) Subservicer (name, if applicable).

rubrics_metrics.name: Asset subject to demand
rubrics_metrics.description: Indicate whether the loan was subject to a demand to repurchase or replace for breach of representations and warranties, and provide details if so.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provide yes/no whether loan was subject to demand during reporting period. If yes, include: (1) Status of asset subject to demand (code describing status of repurchase/replacement demand as of period end); (2) Repurchase amount (amount paid to repurchase loan from pool); (3) Demand resolution date (date repurchase/replacement demand was resolved); (4) Repurchaser (name of repurchaser); (5) Repurchase or replacement reason (code describing reason for repurchase/replacement).

rubrics_metrics.name: Information related to loans that have been charged off
rubrics_metrics.description: Provide charge-off amounts if loan has been charged off.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Include: (1) Charged-off principal amount (total uncollected principal charged off); (2) Charged-off interest amount (total uncollected interest charged off).

rubrics_metrics.name: [Reserved]
rubrics_metrics.description: Paragraph (k) is reserved.

rubrics_metrics.name: Loss mitigation type indicator
rubrics_metrics.description: Indicate the code that describes the type of loss mitigation the servicer is pursuing with the obligor, loan, or property as of the end of the reporting period.

rubrics_metrics.name: Information related to loan modifications
rubrics_metrics.description: If a loan has been modified from its original terms, provide detailed information about the most recent modification.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Include: (1) Most recent loan modification event type (code describing action changing loan terms); (2) Effective date of most recent loan modification; (3) Post-modification maturity date; (4) Post-modification interest rate type (fixed/adjustable/step/other); (5) Post-modification amortization type; (6) Post-modification interest rate (rate in effect as of modification effective payment date); (7) Post-modification first payment date; (8) Post-modification loan balance (as reported on modification documents); (9) Post-modification principal and interest payment (total P&I as of modification effective payment date); (10) Total capitalized amount (amount added to principal due to modification); (11) Income verification indicator (at modification) (yes/no whether Form 4506-T transcript was obtained/considered); (12) Modification front-end DTI (front-end DTI used to qualify modification); (13) Modification back-end DTI; (14) Total deferred amount (deferred amount that is non-interest bearing); (15) Forgiven principal amount (cumulative) (total principal reductions due to mods over life of loan); (16) Forgiven principal amount (reporting period) (principal reduction due to mod during period); (17) Forgiven interest amount (cumulative); (18) Forgiven interest amount (reporting period); (19) Actual ending balance—total debt owed (for principal forbearance include actual ending balance + principal deferred; otherwise actual ending balance); (20) Scheduled ending balance—total debt owed (for principal forbearance include scheduled ending balance + deferred amount; otherwise scheduled ending balance); (21) Information related to ARM loan modifications (if loan was ARM before and after modification include ARM-specific post-modification subfields listed below); (22) Information related to loan modifications involving interest-only periods (post-modification interest-only term and last payment date); (23) Post-modification balloon payment amount (new balloon payment at maturity due to modification, excluding deferred amounts); (24) Information related to step loans (if modification calls for step-up rates provide indicators, all step rates, dates, payments, number of steps, maximum future rate and date to reach it); (25) Non-interest bearing principal deferred amount (cumulative); (26) Non-interest bearing principal deferred amount (reporting period); (27) Recovery of deferred principal (reporting period); (28) Non-interest bearing deferred paid-in-full amount (if loan with principal forbearance was paid in full or liquidated provide amount paid toward forbearance); (29) Non-interest bearing deferred interest and fees amount (reporting period); (30) Non-interest bearing deferred interest and fees amount (cumulative); (31) Recovery of deferred interest and fees (reporting period). ARM-specific post-modification subfields (per item (21)) include: (i) Post-modification ARM indicator (whether ARM parameters changed); (ii) Post-modification ARM index (code describing index used after modification); (iii) Post-modification margin; (iv) Post-modification interest reset period (if changed); (v) Post-modification next reset date; (vi) Post-modification index lookback (days); (vii) Post-modification ARM round indicator (rounding code); (viii) Post-modification ARM round percentage; (ix) Post-modification initial minimum payment; (x) Post-modification next payment adjustment date; (xi) Post-modification ARM payment recast frequency (months); (xii) Post-modification lifetime rate floor; (xiii) Post-modification lifetime rate ceiling; (xiv) Post-modification initial interest rate increase (max % increase at first adjustment after mod); (xv) Post-modification initial interest rate decrease; (xvi) Post-modification subsequent interest rate increase (max percentage points at subsequent adjustments); (xvii) Post-modification subsequent interest rate decrease; (xviii) Post-modification payment cap (percentage value payment may increase/decrease in one period); (xix) Post-modification payment method after recast (code); (xx) Post-modification ARM interest rate teaser period (duration in months); (xxi) Post-modification payment teaser period (duration in months); (xxii) Post-modification ARM negative amortization indicator (yes/no); (xxiii) Post-modification ARM negative amortization cap (max % negative amortization allowed).

rubrics_metrics.name: Information related to forbearance or trial modification
rubrics_metrics.description: If the type of loss mitigation is forbearance or a trial modification, provide specific dates and status fields.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Definition: Forbearance = period with no payment or payment less than contractual; Trial modification = temporary modification while applying for permanent modification. Fields: (1) Most recent forbearance plan or trial modification start date; (2) Most recent forbearance plan or trial modification scheduled end date; (3) Most recent trial modification violated date (date obligor ceased complying with terms).

rubrics_metrics.name: Information related to repayment plan
rubrics_metrics.description: If loss mitigation type is repayment plan, provide start/end/violation dates for the most recent repayment plan.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Fields: (1) Most recent repayment plan start date; (2) Most recent repayment plan scheduled end date; (3) Most recent repayment plan violated date.

rubrics_metrics.name: Information related to short sales
rubrics_metrics.description: If loss mitigation type is short sale, provide short-sale-specific fields.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Fields: (1) Short sale accepted offer amount (amount accepted for pending short sale); (2) [Reserved]. Note: short sale defined as servicer working with delinquent obligor to sell property prior to foreclosure sale.

rubrics_metrics.name: Information related to loss mitigation exit
rubrics_metrics.description: If the loan exited loss mitigation during the reporting period, provide exit date and reason code.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Fields: (1) Most recent loss mitigation exit date; (2) Most recent loss mitigation exit code (code describing why the loss mitigation ended).

rubrics_metrics.name: Information related to loans in the foreclosure process
rubrics_metrics.description: If the loan is in foreclosure, provide foreclosure-related dates and codes.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Fields: (1) Attorney referral date (date loan referred to foreclosure attorney); (2) Foreclosure delay reason (code describing reason for delay); (3) Foreclosure exit date (if loan exited foreclosure during reporting period); (4) Foreclosure exit reason (code describing why foreclosure ended); (5) NOI Date (date servicer sent notice of intent informing obligor of acceleration and pending foreclosure action, if NOI sent).

rubrics_metrics.name: Information related to REO
rubrics_metrics.description: If the loan is real estate owned (REO), provide REO sale and recovery information.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Fields: (1) Most recent accepted REO offer amount (amount accepted for REO pending sale); (2) Most recent accepted REO offer date; (3) Gross liquidation proceeds (if REO sale closed, gross amount due to issuing entity as reported on HUD-1 Line 420); (4) Net sales proceeds (net proceeds received from escrow closing before servicer reimbursement); (5) Reporting period loss amount passed to issuing entity (cumulative loss amount passed through during reporting period, incl. subsequent adjustments and forgiven principal passed through); (6) Cumulative total loss amount passed to issuing entity (loss passed through to date); (7) Subsequent recovery amount (amount recovered during reporting period subsequent to initial gain/loss recognized at liquidation); (8) Eviction indicator (whether eviction process has begun); (9) REO exit date (date loan exited REO during reporting period); (10) REO exit reason (code describing reason loan exited REO status).

rubrics_metrics.name: Information related to losses
rubrics_metrics.description: Loss-claim and liquidation-related fields to report losses and reimbursements.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Include information related to loss claims such as: (i) UPB at liquidation (actual unpaid principal balance at liquidation); (ii) Servicing fees claimed (amount of accrued servicing fees claimed at servicer reimbursement after liquidation); (iii) Servicer advanced amounts reimbursed—principal (total unpaid principal advances reimbursed to servicer); (iv) Servicer advanced amounts reimbursed—interest (total unpaid interest advances reimbursed); (v) Servicer advanced amount reimbursed—taxes and insurance (amount reimbursed for escrow advances) and any other applicable loss-claim reimbursement fields as required.
